images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 24 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 76 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a light grey cropped wool jacket with a brown faux fur collar (short hip-length), a small burgundy leather shoulder bag, a sky blue cotton button-down shirt folded together with a plain black crew-neck t-shirt, navy wide-leg trousers, black leather derby shoes. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean man in his 20s wearing exactly the same items: the light grey cropped fur-collar jacket open over the black t-shirt, the sky blue shirt layered underneath with its hem hanging out long below the short jacket hem, navy wide-leg trousers covering the shoes, the burgundy bag on one shoulder, walking on a quiet Seoul Seongsu-dong street with red brick walls and no signs, only in the lower 76 percent, headless body-only framing cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft overcast daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
